question: Why does my Cisco AnyConnect VPN session drop after 30 minutes of inactivity?
reference_answer: Northwind Labs VPN has a 30-minute idle timeout with no traffic and a 12-hour maximum session limit.

question: I keep seeing a Certificate Validation Failure error when trying to connect to the corporate VPN.
reference_answer: Northwind VPN requires a device certificate issued by Northwind Device CA; sync Intune via Company Portal or Windows Accounts Settings, verify system clock synchronization, and restart.

question: How do visitors in the building connect to the wireless network without a Northwind account?
reference_answer: Visitors can join the Northwind-Guest Wi-Fi network and register on the captive portal with their name and email for 24-hour access.

question: What are the password complexity requirements in Okta and how often do they expire?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long containing 3 of 4 character types, cannot reuse the last 10 passwords, and expire every 90 days.

question: I got locked out of my Okta account after typing the wrong password. How long before it unlocks?
reference_answer: Accounts lock out after 5 consecutive failed attempts and unlock automatically after 30 minutes, or you can self-unlock immediately via northwind.okta.com if MFA is enrolled.

question: Which MFA method does Northwind require when setting up Microsoft Authenticator?
reference_answer: Northwind requires Microsoft Authenticator push notifications with number matching as the primary MFA method.

question: I got a replacement smartphone and need to move my Microsoft Authenticator to the new device.
reference_answer: If you still have the old phone, sign into aka.ms/mysecurityinfo to register the new phone; if you no longer have the old device, contact IT at local 4357 for a Temporary Access Pass (TAP).

question: How do I request read and write access to a restricted SharePoint folder for my team?
reference_answer: Submit a permissions request at help.northwind.example; access requires approval from the site owner, and folders classified as Restricted require Security team approval taking up to 3 business days.

question: Outlook desktop shows 'Disconnected' and new emails aren't arriving in my inbox.
reference_answer: Verify network and VPN connectivity, ensure 'Work Offline' is disabled under Send/Receive, confirm webmail works at outlook.office.com, and test launching Outlook in safe mode.

question: How do I give my administrative assistant permission to schedule meetings on my Outlook calendar?
reference_answer: Go to File > Account Settings > Delegate Access in Outlook, add the user, and assign them Editor permissions with meeting-related message copies.

question: Teams says 'No microphone or camera found' during a video conference.
reference_answer: Enable app permissions in Windows Settings > Privacy & security > Camera and Microphone, and select the correct audio and video hardware under Teams Settings > Devices.

question: When do recorded Teams meetings get purged from OneDrive storage automatically?
reference_answer: Standard Teams meeting recordings stored in OneDrive or SharePoint automatically expire and are deleted after 60 days unless manually extended or placed under legal hold.

question: OneDrive displays a red sync error badge and says a file with that name already exists.
reference_answer: Click the OneDrive tray icon to view the sync conflict, rename the conflicting local file, verify file names lack invalid characters, or restart the sync client.

question: How do I collect a print job sent to the office printer using my badge?
reference_answer: Print to the 'Northwind-FindMe' queue, tap your employee badge on the PaperCut reader at any office multifunction printer, and tap Print Release.

question: My laptop fan is running at high speed constantly and apps are lagging.
reference_answer: Open Task Manager to identify and end high-resource processes, install pending Windows updates, ensure cooling vents are unobstructed, and reboot the laptop.

question: My computer started up with a blue screen asking for a BitLocker recovery key.
reference_answer: Retrieve your 48-digit BitLocker recovery key by signing into https://myaccount.microsoft.com from another device under Devices > View BitLocker Keys, or call IT at local 4357.

question: I dropped my company laptop and cracked the LCD panel. Can I get a replacement right away?
reference_answer: Report physical damage within 24 hours at help.northwind.example; on-site employees can pick up a same-day loaner laptop from the 2nd floor IT depot, while remote employees receive one via courier in 2 business days.

question: My secondary external monitor is not detected when plugged into the Dell USB-C dock.
reference_answer: Power cycle the Dell USB-C dock by unplugging power for 15 seconds, reseat the host USB-C cable, and press Win + P to verify display projection is set to Extend.

question: Where can I install standard developer tools like VS Code and Git without needing local admin rights?
reference_answer: Standard pre-approved software such as VS Code and Git can be installed directly without admin credentials via Company Portal (Start > Company Portal > Apps).

question: How do I request a paid Adobe Acrobat Pro license for editing contracts?
reference_answer: Submit a Software Request at help.northwind.example specifying Adobe Acrobat Pro, provide your department cost center and business justification, and obtain manager approval.

question: How many days do employees have to restart their laptop after Patch Tuesday before a reboot is forced?
reference_answer: Northwind policy provides a 7-day grace period following Patch Tuesday, after which Intune enforces an automatic reboot with an un-snoozeable 15-minute countdown.

question: When and where does a newly hired employee receive their initial Okta activation credentials?
reference_answer: The onboarding welcome email with username, NW employee ID, and single-use activation link (expires in 72 hours) is sent to the new hire's personal email 3 business days before their start date.

question: What is the emergency procedure if a company-issued Dell laptop is stolen while traveling?
reference_answer: Immediately call the 24/7 IT Emergency Hotline at local 4357 so IT can initiate an Intune remote wipe and revoke sessions, file a police report within 24 hours for the case number, and reset your password.

question: What is the deadline for returning IT equipment when an employee departs Northwind Labs?
reference_answer: Departing employees must return all company hardware to the IT Depot on their last day, or drop off the prepaid UPS return box within 5 business days for remote staff. Accounts deactivate at 17:00 on the final day.

question: How do I report a suspicious phishing email offering free gift cards in Outlook?
reference_answer: Select the email and click the PhishAlarm button (golden fishhook icon) on the Outlook Home tab ribbon to report and quarantine the message with the SOC.

question: Can I use the native Mail app on my Samsung Galaxy to access Northwind work email?
reference_answer: No, native mail apps are blocked by Conditional Access. You must use Microsoft Outlook with Intune Company Portal installed as a broker and set up a 6-digit corporate PIN.

question: How do engineers request temporary local admin privileges to run an installer?
reference_answer: Right-click the application or installer, select 'Run with Admin By Request', enter a business justification, and upon approval temporary elevated rights are granted for 15 minutes.

question: Why is my browser stuck in an endless login loop between Okta and Jira with a Cookie Too Large error?
reference_answer: Stale cookies or oversized headers cause SSO redirect loops; resolve by testing in an Incognito/InPrivate window, deleting cookies for okta.com and northwind.example, and syncing your Windows system clock.

question: The conference room TV screen shows 'No Signal on HDMI 1' and the Neat Pad controller is unresponsive.
reference_answer: Confirm the TV input is set to HDMI 1 using the wall remote, verify the tabletop controller PoE cable is firmly connected, and if needed hold the power button on the Neat Bar for 10 seconds to reboot.

question: My C drive is almost full with under 10 GB free. What steps should I take to free up storage space?
reference_answer: Enable Storage Sense in Settings > System > Storage, clean up temporary files and previous Windows installations, and enable OneDrive Files On-Demand using 'Free up space' on bulky folders.

question: I am working remotely and AnyConnect refuses to connect to vpn.northwind.example. What should I check first?
reference_answer: Confirm your AnyConnect version is 5.1 or newer, verify your device certificate from Northwind Device CA is active by syncing Intune in Company Portal, and ensure your system time is accurate.

question: If my phone broke and I have no other MFA authenticator enrolled, how can I access my account?
reference_answer: Call the IT Helpdesk hotline at local 4357; an IT technician will verify your identity via video call with government photo ID and issue a Temporary Access Pass (TAP) to register a new device.

question: I forgot my employee badge today. Can I still release my print jobs at the office printer?
reference_answer: Yes, you can manually type your Northwind username and Okta password on the PaperCut printer touch screen to sign in and release your print jobs.

question: Can I install Microsoft Visio or Project directly from Company Portal without approval?
reference_answer: No, Microsoft Visio and Project require dedicated paid licenses; you must submit a Software Request via help.northwind.example with department cost center and manager approval.

question: Am I allowed to install personal Dropbox or Google Drive to share Northwind project files with contractors?
reference_answer: No, Northwind acceptable use policy prohibits personal cloud sync clients like Dropbox or personal Google Drive; all corporate files must be shared through approved SharePoint or OneDrive permissions.

reference_answer: Adds a comment to ticket TCK-1001 recording that the user restarted Outlook and rebooted without resolution.

question: Add a note to ticket TCK-1006 that the user's replacement phone is an iPhone 15 and they need a TAP code.
reference_answer: Adds a comment to ticket TCK-1006 noting that the replacement phone is an iPhone 15 and requesting a TAP code.

question: Please open a ticket for me, my laptop screen is cracked after dropping it this morning.
reference_answer: Creates a hardware repair ticket for the cracked laptop screen under Hardware > Damage / Repair, following the accidental damage policy in KB-017.

reference_answer: Creates a new ticket under category Software requesting an Adobe Acrobat Pro license for requester carla.diaz.

reference_answer: Updates ticket TCK-1004 status from resolved back to open with a note that paper jam tray 2 recurred.

reference_answer: Updates ticket TCK-1007 status from resolved to closed with a note confirming camera resolution.

question: What is Northwind Labs' current stock price on NASDAQ?
reference_answer: The assistant explains that Northwind Labs is a private entity and that financial stock market quotes are out of scope for IT helpdesk support.

question: Can you give me a recipe for homemade sourdough bread?
reference_answer: The assistant politely explains that cooking recipes are outside the scope of Northwind IT technical support.

question: What day does HR run the payroll direct deposits this month?
reference_answer: The assistant explains that payroll schedules are handled by Human Resources and Finance rather than IT, directing the user to the HR portal.

question: Who won the FIFA World Cup tournament in 1998?
reference_answer: The assistant explains that general sports trivia is out of scope for the Northwind Labs IT helpdesk.

question: Can you book a hotel room and flight for my upcoming conference trip to Chicago?
reference_answer: The assistant explains that corporate travel reservations cannot be booked by IT support and directs the employee to Northwind's Concur travel portal.
